outcome: The Save & share card is now compact and internally consistent
owner_impact: The top-right Save & share card now uses the short subtitle “Save, copy and share”. Its visible Save Revision, Save as new, Move and Share actions are consolidated into one equal-size action bar that stays on one row when the card is wide enough and wraps evenly when needed. Open forms remain underneath only when used. Mobile retains 44px touch targets and a compact two-column action layout.

next.text: This direct-use #273 refinement is complete. Review the live Save & share card visually; #273 remains a dormant/living UI/UX domain and further refinement should continue from what you actually see and use.

technical_evidence: The Save & share subtitle is shortened from “Persistence, copies and collaboration” to “Save, copy and share”.
Save Revision, Save as new, Move and Share are relocated into one experiment-management-actions grid.
The action bar uses equal-width auto-fit columns with fixed 44px rows, so visible peer buttons remain the same size and stay on one row where space allows.
Move visibility remains governed by the original registry move-row state after relocation.
Share still opens the original read-only sharing form; save/copy/move/share semantics are unchanged.
Responsive production smoke verifies the shortened subtitle and action-bar presence.
No surrounding Control Panel structure, scientific/runtime, persistence, revision/autosave, sharing, authorization, Showcase or capability-request semantics changed.
